opening: An elderly man visits the library every week to borrow books. Before choosing any book, he always opens it to page thirty. Why?
answer: The man cannot read. He borrows books for his child, who has difficulty walking and cannot easily visit the library. After finishing a book, the child leaves a mark on page thirty. The father checks that page before borrowing: if he finds the mark, he knows his child has already read the book and chooses another one.
